description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Virgin Islands Code (V.I.C., US Virgin Islands statutes, 2026 edition) by citation, e.g. "14 V.I.C. section 922" (first and second degree murder) or "11A V.I.C. section 2-201" (UCC statute of frauds). Accepts "14 V.I.C. section 922", "14 VIC 922", "V.I. Code Ann. tit. 14, section 922" or "Title 14, Section 922". Returns the statutory text, the heading, and the "History:" amendment line. Source: USVI Public Records, Virgin Islands Code 2026 edition. Keyless.

citation.description: Citation as "<title> V.I.C. section <section>", e.g. "14 V.I.C. section 922" or "11A V.I.C. section 2-201".

name: vi_statute
title: Vi Statute
